blocks.text: Mastering Zoom keyboard shortcuts on Mac

Efficiency in a sales call starts with knowing your shortcuts. You do not want to hunt for the mute button while a prospect is talking. Open your Zoom Settings by pressing ⌘ + , then go to Keyboard Shortcuts. You can map your most used actions to keys that make sense for your workflow. For example, setting ⌥ + A to mute and unmute is faster than moving your cursor. Keep your hands on the keyboard to maintain eye contact with the camera.

Your Mac setup matters as much as your pitch. Use a consistent background to avoid distractions. You can learn how to change your virtual background in Zoom on Mac: step by step for Zoom Workplace if you need to hide a messy office. Make sure your camera is at eye level. If you are using a MacBook, consider an external monitor so you can see your notes on one screen and the prospect on the other.
Common Zoom issues for sales reps

items: Audio input selection: Always check your microphone in Settings > Audio before a call.
Camera permissions: If your video fails, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera.
Screen share visibility: Learn how to share screen in Zoom on Mac: desktop steps, shortcuts and black screen fixes to avoid dead air.
Meeting links: Use the copy invite link feature to send meeting details quickly.

blocks.text: Reducing admin time with better workflows

Sales reps spend too much time on data entry. Your goal is to move from the Zoom call directly to your CRM. Use a clipboard manager like Maccy to keep your prospect data ready. If you find yourself toggling between apps, try using a sidebar organizer to keep your deal tabs in one place. Do not let the tech slow you down.

faq.question: How can I improve my screen sharing in Zoom on Mac?
faq.answer: Check your macOS permissions in System Settings and ensure you are using the latest version of Zoom. If you see a black screen, you may need to restart the app or grant screen recording permissions.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur while on a Zoom call?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur is designed to run in the background. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ to ask a question, and it will answer without interrupting your call.

faq.question: What is the best way to manage meeting links?
faq.answer: Use the copy invite link feature within the Zoom meeting window. You can also connect Zoom to your calendar to automate the process.
